original_target.title: Uniform semi-limit-cycle bounds on planar grids

verification: Literature and theorem-scope review; no independent whole-proof or Lean verification.
scope_comparison: Original globally continuous grid-affine planar fields, fixed numbers r,s of grid lines and semi-limit cycles including one-sided attraction/repulsion. Panazzolo §5.5 poses this precise uniform question. Polynomial Hilbert16 announcements concern polynomial vector fields and cannot be substituted for continuous piecewise-affine nonsmooth grid fields. Located piecewise-constant, discontinuous-switching and variable smooth-regularization results also have different classes. Bounded current searches found no full match; not a certification of openness.
